newsitem.title: USA: DMX, TCI in marketing pact.
newsitem.headline: DMX, TCI in marketing pact.

text.p: DMX Inc and TCI Satellite Entertainment Inc (TSAT) said Saturday said they had entered into an agreement to jointly offer Primestar's television programming and DMX music services to commercial customers.

Primestar, a direct broadcast satellite television company, is owned by a host of cable television operators. TSAT, which was formerly part of Tele-Communications Inc, has a 20.86 percent interest in Primestar.
The companies said the DMX/Primestar commercial service will be available to businesses located in what it termed as TSAT's Primestar "territories throughout the United States."

More than 90 channels of DMX music and up to 160 channels of Primestar digital television programming will be marketed by DMX for Business, the commercial arm of DMX Inc, through a single antenna, the companies said.
Earlier this year, DMX and Tele-Communications Inc had announced a definitive merger agreement under which DMX will become a wholly owned unit of TCI Music Inc, a Tele-Communications subsidiary.
